about_the_game:
After the first game, Peter made it to the Moon. However, he soon discovers that the moon is inhabited by Moon Rabbits. Peter is taken to the Moon Princess who offers Peter a way to live on the moon. Peter must complete a trial by collecting all the treasure that has been scattered about the Moon. This may not be an easy task since the moon has tons of obstacles Peter accepts and the trail begins!

Balloon to the Moon 2 is a platformer adventure where you bounce on balloons and avoid hazards. Unlike the first game, this is not a linear left to right level based platformer. The game is one big map where you can explore to your hearts content. However, you will need to explore every corner and bring your best platforming skills in order to collect every single treasure scattered about the moon! Good Luck!

Explore the vast landscape of the Moon. From exploring the deep caverns to jumping above the clouds, the sacred treasure is hidden all throughout the moon and it will take great skill to find and retrieve all of them. 

Featuring over 30 areas and plenty of challenges await the player in each area. There is even an extensive post-game that will keep your coming back for more secrets and discoveries. Your curiosity is the limit.

short_description: Explore the Moon in this open world 2D platformer with over 30 areas. Find all the sacred treasures to please the Moon Princess! Explore the deep caverns of the moon and soar above the clouds. But there is more than what all might seem!
